about.body: The AJ133 is Jaguar Land Rover's third-generation AJ-V8 engine, a 5.0-litre 90° V8 produced from 2009 to 2024. It's the definitive modern Jaguar V8, fitted across the flagship performance variants of every model line - from the F-Pace SVR and F-Type R/SVR to the XE Project 8, XF XFR/XFR-S, XJ Supersport/XJR, and XK XKR/XKR-S. Both naturally aspirated (385-470 hp) and supercharged (470-575 hp) versions exist, with the supercharged variants appearing across the majority of applications we work on.

byModel.body: Across the F-Pace, the AJ133 powers the SVR (X761, 2016-2024), making it one of the most powerful SUVs Jaguar has produced. The F-Type uses the supercharged AJ133 in its R and SVR variants (X152, 2013-2024), delivering up to 575 hp. The XE received the AJ133 in its limited-run Project 8 (X760, 2018-2020) - the most powerful saloon Jaguar ever built. The XF uses the engine in the XFR and XFR-S (X250, 2009-2015), with the XFR-S producing 550 hp. The XJ uses it in the XJ Supersport and XJR (X351, 2009-2019). The XK uses it in the XKR and XKR-S (X150, 2009-2014).

compatibility.body: Because the AJ133 spans six different models and multiple performance variants - from the naturally aspirated 385 hp version in earlier XF and XJ applications to the 575 hp supercharged SVR tune in the F-Pace and F-Type - compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and powertrain spec, which we do by registration. An AJ133 from an XF isn't a drop-in match for an AJ133 from an F-Pace SVR - ancillaries, mounting, ECU calibration, and supercharger tune all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.

AJ133 Supercharged Applications: F-Type R, F-Pace SVR, XFR, XJR, XKR, XKR-S (470-575 hp).
